_approach: Beat bolha keeps the tamborzão's swing and syncopation but strips the kit back to almost nothing: a tight kick on the downbeats, a soft clap on 2 and 4, and delicate, widely-spaced percussion so the 'bubble' synths and vocal chops have room. Per production guides, work in the 120-145 BPM pocket and keep density low rather than layering a full kit. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
